text_block_list.text: One day, as summer training camp entered its final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Today's joint training session is over,
but I wanted to do a bit more independent practice."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've prepared a menu—would you mind taking a quick look?

Looking at the paper handed to me,
I saw a meticulous yet grueling regimen
broken down by each ability to be trained.
choice_data_list: Did Dober come up with this?
Did Dober come up with this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it.
There's no way I could come up with something this detailed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...That's the menu
Air Groove-senpai put together
for us younger students.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"She said she made it mainly for voluntary practice,
'so that everyone can have a great training camp.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right?
I really wanted to try this workout routine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pick a menu from these
that suits me right now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Could you pick a menu from these
that suits me right now, Trainer?

"After quickly reviewing everything,
the menu that seems best suited to developing Mejiro Dober's current abilities is—"

"After quickly reviewing everything,
the menu that seems best suited to developing Mejiro Dober's current abilities is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right... it's a workout routine
that pushes every part of the body evenly, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, Ryan would probably like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer, set the number of sets for me
and make the load pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer, could you set the number of sets for me
and make the load pretty tough?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go all out for the Shuka Sho.
To push past my current limits."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go all out for the Shuka Sho.
To push past my current limits."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you push me with all you've got.
Just so you know, I'm not gonna
whine or give up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay to push me as hard as you can.
I'll see it through to the end."

Afterward, with the setting sun behind us,
Mejiro Dober and I began a scorching
strength training regimen...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not yet...!

"It had to be remarkably tough, but Mejiro Dober
steadily pushed through without a single complaint...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Dober...! Such incredible spirit...
even under such a massive strain...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Dober's Trainer!
Is she going to be all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I mean, of course I think everything will be fine, but...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, well... I was worried
she might be pushing herself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan.
I'll be fine, don't worry."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dober...!!
You're fine... Are you really sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Thanks for worrying about me.
But this isn't me "pushing myself too hard"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's a "challenge."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...To my very limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back in a little bit...
See ya then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it... she's learned
how to make a face like that, hasn't she?
choice_data_list: You're growing so much every day, you know.
You're growing so much every day, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see. I feel happy, but also
a little lonely... hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Dober! Let me join in too!
Let's push our muscles to the limit together!

Afterward, Mejiro Ryan joined in, and the two
of them worked up a glistening sweat under
the sunset sky...!
